resources.string: Off by default. Send barcodes to Open Food Facts to offer names and categories. You confirm each name. Scanning always works without a connection.

If you enable barcode lookup, Usuals sends scanned barcodes directly to Open Food Facts for product names, categories and product details. Barcodes Open Food Facts files as non-food also go to its sister database for that kind of product (Open Beauty Facts, Open Products Facts or Open Pet Food Facts). Your lists and purchase history are never sent. Lookup is off by default.
